content:
Whether it’s a camel roaming the Saudi desert or a wild gazelle in a royal reserve, animals deserve to be safe and traceable.
That’s why we’ve created Custodia: a modular tracking platform using LoRa mesh, GPS, satellite fallback, and smart alerts.
🐫 Camel owners can stop worrying about lost animals.
 🚧 Governments can prevent deadly accidents.
 🌍 Wildlife managers can monitor species in real time.
We believe technology can make animal care more humane, efficient, and connected — even in the world’s harshest environments.
Follow us as we pilot, test, and scale. This is just the beginning.

content:
Behind every Custodia tracker is a small but determined founding team:
👨‍🔬 Gilberto Castro Sustaita — our CTO.
 An Electrical Engineer with experience in R&D at Schaeffler, Gilberto now applies his passion for innovation to develop Custodia’s IoT animal trackers. He leads the design of our LoRa and Meshtastic-based systems, as well as our satellite-enabled solution.
👩‍💻 Julia Sergeeva — our CEO.
 With a background in applied mathematics, product management, and e-commerce startups, Julia drives customer discovery, fundraising, brand building, and the development of our dashboard and digital presence.

✨ What unites us?
-> A love for learning and using modern tech to transform established markets.
-> A shared belief that animals deserve better care.
-> A mission to engineer tracking technology that is robust, scalable, and truly animal-centered.

We’re building Custodia to protect endangered wildlife and improve animal safety in harsh environments.
If you’re working in wildlife conservation, ag-tech, or rural infrastructure, we’d love to connect and exchange ideas.
